fullText.simplified:
第11章、一个决定，一次游街

    包公相信王家三兄弟不是杀人凶手，但他找不到任何人帮忙说出那天到底发生了什么。除非有人站出来，否则王三只能去死了。可是，怎样才能让人站出来说出真正的情况呢？
    包公放下手中的工作，私下找了几个人，请他们一起四处询问史元的事，想探查出更多有用的东西。
    下人很快就询问回来了。史元这些年做了不少坏事。他觉得自己是公主的侄子，就可以想做什么就做什么。他到街上吃喝从不给钱，看到漂亮的女人就抢走。如果有人不答应他，他就上门去打一顿，打死也没关系。
    不仅是史元做坏事，连他的家人、下人也一样，看到谁不高兴就打一顿，也不会有人敢告诉官府。
    包公知道了这些事，生气极了。他决定要把这些坏人抓进大牢。
    一个下人对包公说：“您真要这么做吗？史元是皇帝的亲戚，动了史家的人，皇帝应该会不高兴的。”
    也有人说：“王三都已经说了，就是他动手杀了史元。这件事本来都定好了，我们还是别再自找麻烦了吧！多一事不如少一事。”
    但包公没有犹豫，他说：“你们说的我都懂。但如果王三真是个好人，我们怎么能让他就这样死了？而且，如果我这次没有保护好人，以后其他人也不会相信我，相信法律了！”
    包公心里好像烧了一把火，他宁可不要这条命，也必须要做点什么来惩罚史家，还王家三兄弟一个清白。
    如果皇帝不允许他做，那就先不告诉皇帝；如果公主不允许他做，那就先不告诉公主。等事情结束了，他们再不高兴也没办法了！
    包公这样想着，就直接去了史家，抓走了这些人。把人给抓来后，他还让下人带他们去游街，并让下人在游街的时候大声地说出这些史家人做过什么坏事。
    游街，是件很丢脸的事情。史家的坏人们被抓起来，还得在街上一圈一圈地走，他们能接受这样的惩罚吗？皇帝和公主知道后，会放过包公吗？
    包公没有想这些，他一点也不怕。他想起自己做官这么多年，遇到的坏人不少，而且皇帝很早就送给他一把“尚方宝剑”，这把剑可以杀任何人，不管这个人当多大的官，有多有钱，只要做了坏事，这把“尚方宝剑”都可以杀他。
    包公看着“尚方宝剑”，心想：“皇帝送我宝剑，就是想让我办案公正。我相信这次我的决定是正确的。”
fullText.traditional:
第11章、一個決定，一次遊街

    包公相信王家三兄弟不是殺人兇手，但他找不到任何人幫忙說出那天到底發生了什麼。除非有人站出來，否則王三只能去死了。可是，怎樣才能讓人站出來說出真正的情況呢？
    包公放下手中的工作，私下找了幾個人，請他們一起四處詢問史元的事，想探查出更多有用的東西。
    下人很快就詢問回來了。史元這些年做了不少壞事。他覺得自己是公主的姪子，就可以想做什麼就做什麼。他到街上吃喝從不給錢，看到漂亮的女人就搶走。如果有人不答應他，他就上門去打一頓，打死也沒關係。
    不僅是史元做壞事，連他的家人、下人也一樣，看到誰不高興就打一頓，也不會有人敢告訴官府。
    包公知道了這些事，生氣極了。他決定要把這些壞人抓進大牢。
    一個下人對包公說：“您真要這麼做嗎？史元是皇帝的親戚，動了史家的人，皇帝應該會不高興的。”
    也有人說：“王三都已經說了，就是他動手殺了史元。這件事本來都定好了，我們還是別再自找麻煩了吧！多一事不如少一事。”
    但包公沒有猶豫，他說：“你們說的我都懂。但如果王三真是個好人，我們怎麼能讓他就這樣死了？而且，如果我這次沒有保護好人，以後其他人也不會相信我，相信法律了！”
    包公心裡好像燒了一把火，他寧可不要這條命，也必須要做點什麼來懲罰史家，還王家三兄弟一個清白。
    如果皇帝不允許他做，那就先不告訴皇帝；如果公主不允許他做，那就先不告訴公主。等事情結束了，他們再不高興也沒辦法了！
    包公這樣想著，就直接去了史家，抓走了這些人。把人給抓來後，他還讓下人帶他們去遊街，並讓下人在遊街的時候大聲地說出這些史家人做過什麼壞事。
    遊街，是件很丟臉的事情。史家的壞人們被抓起來，還得在街上一圈一圈地走，他們能接受這樣的懲罰嗎？皇帝和公主知道後，會放過包公嗎？
    包公沒有想這些，他一點也不怕。他想起自己做官這麼多年，遇到的壞人不少，而且皇帝很早就送給他一把“尚方寶劍”，這把劍可以殺任何人，不管這個人當多大的官，有多有錢，只要做了壞事，這把“尚方寶劍”都可以殺他。
    包公看著“尚方寶劍”，心想：“皇帝送我寶劍，就是想讓我辦案公正。我相信這次我的決定是正確的。”

sentences.pinyin: bù guǎn zhè ge rén dāng duō dà de guān yǒu duō yǒu qián zhǐ yào zuò le huài shì zhè bǎ shàng fāng bǎo jiàn dōu kě yǐ shā tā
sentences.english: As long as they did bad things, this “imperial sword” could kill them.

sentences.simplified: 包公看着“尚方宝剑”，心想：
sentences.traditional: 包公看著“尚方寶劍”，心想：
sentences.pinyin: bāo gōng kàn zhe shàng fāng bǎo jiàn xīn xiǎng
sentences.english: Lord Bao looked at the “imperial sword” and thought to himself, ..

sentences.simplified: “皇帝送我宝剑，就是想让我办案公正。我相信这次我的决定是正确的。”
sentences.traditional: “皇帝送我寶劍，就是想讓我辦案公正。我相信這次我的決定是正確的。”
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì sòng wǒ bǎo jiàn jiù shì xiǎng ràng wǒ bàn àn gōng zhèng wǒ xiāng xìn zhè cì wǒ de jué dìng shì zhèng què de
sentences.english: .. “The emperor gave me this sword because he wanted me to deliver justice. I believe I made the right decision in this case.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 11: A Decision, a Parade
Lord Bao believed that the three Wang brothers were not the killers, ..
.. but he could not find anyone willing to help and say what really happened that day.
Unless someone came forward, Wang San would have to die.
But how could they get someone to come forward and say what really happened?
Lord Bao stopped what he was doing. He sought out some people in private and had them ask around about Shi Yuan.
He wanted to find out more useful things.
The servants quickly returned after their inquiries. Shi Yuan had done many bad things over the years.
He thought that because he was the nephew of the princess, he could do whatever he wanted.
He never paid for food and drink in town and snatched beautiful women when he saw them.
If someone didn’t say yes to him, he would come around and give them a beating. It didn’t matter if they died.
And it wasn’t just Shi Yuan who did bad things. Even his family and his servants were the same.
They would beat up anyone that they didn’t like the look of, and no one dared to tell the authorities.
Lord Bao was furious when he found out about this. He decided that he would put these bad people in jail.
A servant said to Lord Bao, “Do you really want to do this? Shi Yuan is a relative of the emperor.
If you act against the Shi family, the emperor will be unhappy.”
Someone else also said, “Wang San has already said that he was the one who killed Shi Yuan.
This matter is already settled. Let’s stop looking for trouble! The less trouble, the better.”
But Lord Bao did not hesitate and said, ..
.. “I understand what you are saying. But if Wang San really is a good person, how can we let him die like this?
Also, if I don’t protect the good people this time, no one else will trust me or trust the law in the future!”
It was like there was a flame in Lord Bao’s heart.
He knew it might cost him his life, but he had to do something to punish the Shi family and clear the three Wang brothers.
If the emperor wouldn’t allow him to do this, then he wouldn’t tell the emperor before he did it.
If the princess wouldn’t allow him to do this, then he wouldn’t tell the princess before he did it.
When it was all over, there would be nothing they could do if they didn’t like it!
With this in mind, Lord Bao went straight to the Shi household and arrested these people.
After arresting these people, he had his servants parade them through the street, ..
.. and had the servants say out loud what bad things these people from the Shi had done as they paraded them.
It was very humiliating to be paraded through the streets.
When the bad people from the Shi family were arrested, would they accept such a punishment and walk around the streets?
After the emperor and the princess found out, would they let Lord Bao get away with this?
Lord Bao did not think about these things. He was not afraid at all.
He remembered that he had been an official for many years and had encountered many bad people.
The emperor had given him an “imperial sword” a long time ago.
This sword could kill any bad person, no matter if they were very important officials or had a lot of money.
As long as they did bad things, this “imperial sword” could kill them.
Lord Bao looked at the “imperial sword” and thought to himself, ..
.. “The emperor gave me this sword because he wanted me to deliver justice. I believe I made the right decision in this case.”
